title: Multifunctional copolymers for brilliant green dye removal: adsorption kinetics, isotherm and process optimization
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4VA00404C, Paper

Yassin A. Aggour, El-Refaie Kenawy, Marwa Magdy, Elsayed Elbayoumy
Poly(AN-co-AMPS) was synthesized via free radical polymerization for brilliant green dye removal. It showed high adsorption efficiency, stability, and reusability, making it a promising eco-friendly adsorbent for wastewater treatment.
